scope: Index-only inventory of the ICRSP France Office divin, Roman Ritual and Advent Great O sections; NOT complete 1962 Divine Office and NOT new standalone devotional prayers.
rules: Every directory row is an indexed source entry, not a verified, full text or new prayer.
1962 Divine Office is a separate structured project; selection here is only ICRSP France's displayed excerpted set.
Psalm numeration is Vulgate; segmented Psalm 9, 143, 144 are fragments, not new psalms.
The index includes pre-1955 variants; no claim of universal 1962 applicability before office/rubrical comparison.
Original 94 owner keys are only match candidates; preserve language witness and edition identity.
